resources.string: Games from your RomM server: library, firmware, saves and save states
Play the games of your RomM server; saves and states stay on the server.
Shows the server\'s games in the menu and plays them in the game player.

Enter the address of the RomM web interface.
Shows a code and a QR code; approve this device on a phone signed in to RomM (RomM 5 or later).
Scan the code with a phone that is signed in to RomM, or open the address and enter the code. Then approve this device.

For RomM games, save states, in-game saves and firmware are kept on the server: a game continues on any device. Firmware is added per platform in RomM. Controller layouts, cores and picture settings are the same as for local games. Without a connection the last copy is played; changes are sent once the server answers again.
